purpose: Continuously age, rank and retire silo offers without changing the economic truth layer.

principles.unknown_is_not_zero: Missing evidence never becomes a neutral trend score.
principles.recency_decay: Old evidence loses influence unless refreshed.
principles.velocity_matters: Acceleration/deceleration matters in addition to volume.
principles.crowding_is_negative: More competing offers reduce commercial attractiveness.
principles.revival_requires_new_evidence: A dead or hated trend can return only after fresh positive evidence.
principles.no_revenue_claims: Trend state never creates or modifies verified economic outcomes.
principles.no_auto_external_action: Trend changes may reorder, quarantine or propose offers; consequential external publication remains governed by existing authority.
